detail.longDescription: I just launched Gapfill Plugins: 10 small WordPress and WooCommerce plugins aimed at the gaps that abandoned plugins left behind. About 40% of the WordPress.org directory hasn't been updated in two years, and core WooCommerce still has no cart recovery or lifetime-value reporting. Each plugin does one job, adds no bloat and is GPL-licensed, so use it on as many sites as you like. $19 each or $79 for all 10. https:// gapfill-plugins.vercel.app/api /s?mastodon-launch # WordPress # WooCommerce # WebDev
